decisions.reason: As the flagship organic line with several models and continuous website presence, its high sunk investments and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The firm continues to promote new variants of this multi-model line, so visible commitment and prior investment outweigh any sign of reduced prominence.
Its own-page launch and fit with the announced organic expansion reflect a visible commitment the firm will likely justify by persisting.
A multi-variant organic line with own-page presentation aligns with the firm's strategic direction, making early withdrawal unlikely.
Although launched without a specific promotional quote, its own-page presence and proximity to established products still entail enough public commitment to continue.
